en: I mentioned that there are lots of options
for building AI agents. We already saw EVE.
In the next lectures, I'll show you another
option, CrewAI. And I recorded this a couple
of months ago, but still it is a nice
example of how you could use another
framework and to also see some differences
between frameworks and how they work because
CrewAI, unlike EVE, is not file system
based, as you'll see, so that you also
simply get more ideas of how different
frameworks can tackle the same problem,
